versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this version.

- No file changes found.
- Functionality and documentation remain the same as the previous version.

Initial release of API Documentation Generator.

- Analyzes project codebases to detect frameworks (Express, FastAPI, Django, Rails, and more).
- Extracts API endpoints, HTTP methods, parameters, authentication, and middleware.
- Analyzes types/models to infer request/response schemas and generates realistic examples.
- Produces documentation in Markdown and OpenAPI formats, including error responses and SDK usage samples.
- Completeness check ensures all endpoints, parameters, and errors are documented.
- Outputs coverage stats and highlights undocumented or incomplete endpoints.
